description: Dixon-Coles per league with a goal intercept, L2 shrinkage of attack/defense toward the league mean, a 5-season window and exponential time decay. Settings picked on the 2019-20..2022-23 walk-forward (TUNE) and confirmed on 2023-24..2026-27 (TEST); plan item P1-2. Reproduce: python scripts/eval_soccer_walkforward.py --raw-dir <football-data CSV dir> --test-start 2023 --test-end 2026 --check

measured.note: Walk-forward, refit Mon+Fri on matches strictly before the cut-off; big-5 leagues; football-data.co.uk results to 2026-09-20. Market = football-data closing average, de-vigged, same matches. The model does not beat the market on any measure.
